name: @neuroflame/cli
description: NeuroFLAME command-line client for headless environments (HPC clusters, servers without a GUI)

scripts.compile: npm run build:edge-dep && tsc && npm run chmod-bin
scripts.build: npm run build:edge-dep && tsc && npm run chmod-bin
scripts.prepack: npm run clean && npm run compile
scripts.init: npm install && npm run build && npm install -g .
